out.scope: Covers only the t=1, k=2 interpreter on the two hand-specified oracles true75 and false75. The tests check fixed values and scripted draw paths. The semantic refinement and the ideal-draw distribution link to Lean are not proved here, and the source record also lists the Python-to-Lean oracle link as open.
